test_statement: Treat the Horvath353 age-clock shift as an age_signature-only special case and check that no identity, function, safety, rejuvenation, renewable maintenance, or immortality conclusion is accepted from this contact.
support_condition: Coverage is at least 330/353 and 0.93, eight pairs have the frozen cell-type split, mean treated-minus-normal DNAm age is negative, and the paired sign/t criterion supports the direction while blocked promotions remain blocked.
break_condition: Coverage falls below the floor, the frozen pairing is absent, mean delta is nonnegative, the paired sign/t criterion fails, or any forbidden interpretation is promoted from the methylation-array contact alone.
null_reason: A positive clock shift certificate remains null for promoted biological claims without separate reality contacts for those layers.

test_statement: Check donor-matched GSE165177 exp2 day-10 transiently reprogrammed samples against negative-control fibroblasts using the predeclared fibroblast identity and pluripotency marker panels.
support_condition: At least three donor pairs are present, all identity and pluripotency markers are covered, every donor identity-marker RMS delta is at or below 1.5 Log2 RPM, and no pluripotency marker rises by more than 1.0 Log2 RPM.
break_condition: The packet breaks if sample pairing or marker coverage fails, if identity-marker distance exceeds the threshold, or if any pluripotency marker increase exceeds the threshold.
forbidden_interpretations: A sameSig_I pass alone proves IdentityPreservingAgeResetUp.
A sameSig_I pass alone proves safety, repair, maintenance, organismal outcome, or immortal potential.
null_reason: The probe is scoped to cell_identity; other layers require separate contacts.

test_statement: Join GSE165179 methylation and GSE165177 RNA MPTR contacts by donor, day-10 exp2 transiently reprogrammed condition, and declared control/baseline roles, then require age decrease and sameSig_I in the joined scope.
support_condition: O1/O2/O3 all join across the age and identity contacts; every joined methylation treated-minus-baseline DNAm age delta is negative; identity-marker RMS stays within threshold; and every pluripotency exclusion condition holds.
break_condition: The packet breaks if the join is absent, if any joined age delta is nonnegative, if identity-marker distance exceeds threshold, or if pluripotency markers rise beyond the allowed boundary.
forbidden_interpretations: A same-scope age and identity join proves Rejuvenation↑.
A same-scope age and identity join proves safety K_S, function, renewable maintenance, organismal outcome, or immortal potential.
null_reason: The probe is scoped to the IdentityPreservingAgeReset↑ carrier only; downstream claims require separate layer contacts.

test_statement: Across the full MPTR time series, join GSE165179 methylation age and GSE165177 RNA marker readbacks by exact donor, day, condition, and experiment, then classify each scope into no-age-gain, clock-only, identity-or-safety-break, or identity-safe age-reset candidate cases.
support_condition: Support requires at least one true joined scope with positive DNAm age gain, identity marker RMS at or below 1.5 Log2 RPM, pluripotency marker max delta at or below 1.0 Log2 RPM, and strict no-positive pluripotency-marker deltas.
break_condition: The frontier is negative when all age-gain scopes are clock-only or break the fixed identity/safety thresholds; it is needs_data when the true joined age/RNA scopes are absent or too sparse to evaluate the three-layer relation.
forbidden_interpretations: A frontier scan supplies function, repeat-cycle, organismal, or independent safety-assay contacts.
null_reason: The probe is limited to the finite age x identity x safety promotion frontier under fixed marker thresholds.

break_condition: The probe is needs_data or partial when sample counts are insufficient, marker coverage is incomplete, aggregate directions are nonnegative, or any valid tissue scope fails either negative panel direction.
forbidden_interpretations: Senescence/SASP marker direction proves direct functional rejuvenation.
Mouse in-vivo marker direction generalizes to human or merges with human GSE142439.
The probe establishes IdentityPreservingAgeResetUp, RejuvenationUp, RenewableMaintenanceUp, or ImmortalityPotentialUp.
The probe scores a mouse age clock or applies a human Horvath353 clock to mouse data.
null_reason: The current run has aggregate negative directions but mixed finite-scope directions, so it is partial/needs_data rather than a passed FunctionSignatureShiftUp claim.
support_condition: Support requires complete marker coverage, at least three samples per group in every evaluated scope, aggregate DeltaSen<0 and DeltaSASP<0, and every valid accession-by-tissue scope satisfying both negative panel directions.
test_statement: Compare predeclared mouse senescence and SASP/inflammation marker panels between reprogrammed or dox-treated samples and age-matched controls in each GSE190986 RNA-seq accession-by-tissue scope.
